answers.A_fundingTime: Official USD-M history response field on GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate. Documented by field name and as the history series keyed for startTime/endTime inclusive query bounds. Not documented as publication time or legal_available_at.
answers.B_calc_time: Vision fundingRate CSV column used by the frozen B2-06 contract. Official Vision README does not document this column. Not proven as publication time.
answers.E_predicted_vs_settled_distinguished: PARTIALLY. Current API separates historical fundingRate history from live lastFundingRate and nextFundingTime. Stream field r is labeled only Funding rate. No official historical predicted-funding series is established here.

current_versus_historical.CURRENT_API_SEMANTICS: GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate returns historical fundingRate and fundingTime today. GET /fapi/v1/premiumIndex returns lastFundingRate, nextFundingTime, and time today.
current_versus_historical.HISTORICAL_AVAILABILITY_AUTHORITY: UNPROVEN. Current field presence does not prove when a historical settled value became observable to a market participant.

temporal_claims.claim: GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate history rows include fundingTime and fundingRate.
startTime and endTime filter the funding-rate history series inclusively.
fundingTime is the economic funding-event / settlement clock.
GET /fapi/v1/premiumIndex lastFundingRate is documented as the lasted/latest funding rate on a current mark-price snapshot.
USD-M markPrice stream field r is labeled Funding rate and is pushed every 1s or 3s.
Official Vision daily archive files become available the next day and monthly files on the first Monday of the month.
The historical settled fundingRate was guaranteed known to market participants at fundingTime.
Binance documents a publication latency for settled historical funding.
A completed prior settlement may be used at a later decision boundary because first-party semantics prove public existence before that later boundary.
MARKET-03 LEVEL_2 fundingTime-as-available assumption is scientific authority for MARKET-04.
